title: A free 'weigh what each choice would mean' option existed at the Hollow King's throne and again at the Marrowgate Pass Gate, but no equivalent 'weigh' entry ever appeared at any of the three hold-level grief sites I settled (the Drowned Nave, the Gallows Glade, the Oath-Ground). Costs/benefits at those sites had to be inferred from flavor text and the DC/'a miss costs standing' tags alone.
where: The Drowned Nave (Fenmarch), The Gallows Glade (Thornwold), The Oath-Ground — Circle (Wardmoor)
